finalText:
All 625 tests pass now.

The bug was in `orderTotal` (`src/pricing.js`): it computed tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount, so `discounted + roundCents(cents * taxRate)` overcharged tax. Only rows in the "order totals" suite with both a non-zero discount and non-zero tax rate exposed it — that's why 622/625 tests still passed and the failure was buried in the wall of output. Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`.
